description: This bar chart, titled “Targets,” from the paper “The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targeted” (blue) and “Untargeted” (orange) across each year from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the year, labeled “Year,” and the vertical axis represents the “Number of datasets,” scaled linearly from 0 to 160 with tick marks at intervals of 20. Each bar for a given year is stacked, with the blue segment representing “Targeted” datasets and the orange segment representing “Untargeted” datasets, as indicated by the legend. The chart shows a general upward trend in the total number of datasets over time, with the number of “Targeted” datasets consistently increasing from 2012 (approximately 1 dataset) to 2022 (approximately 10 datasets). The number of “Untargeted” datasets shows a more dramatic increase, rising from approximately 1 dataset in 2012 to a peak of approximately 155 datasets in 2021, before declining to approximately 30 datasets in 2022. The bars are arranged chronologically along the x-axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and stacking.
